outcomes.stage3_wiring: Production Graph entry（runSubagentGraph — every card closeout script invokes it）now runs under the native durable execution seam BY DEFAULT: runSubagentGraph -> runDurableGraph（DurableGraphRun）-> runColimaGraph -> journal + checkpoints; durableExecutionIdFor maps logical run ids to C2D-minted ids deterministically（stable across crash + resume）; durable:false is a TEST-ONLY escape hatch（regression guard asserts no production script uses it）.
outcomes.f1: Post-head journal events are SEMANTICALLY classified (replay-safe / resume-safe / invalid) — DE-1's F1 gap (DAG_ACCEPTED/PHASE_STARTED/EXECUTOR_COMPLETED/REVIEWER_COMPLETED/PHASE_PASSED/PHASE_SKIPPED beyond head refused resume) closed; verified C1-C4.
outcomes.f2_f3: Resumed-orchestrator JOURNAL_OUT_OF_ORDER root cause reproduced (unseeded runner view re-terminals already-passed phases -> result-artifact EEXIST) and fixed by seeding _lastRunnerStatuses from the RECOVERED state set; verified C0/C13/C14 + focused test.
outcomes.writerRecovery: Writer crash boundaries classified（RESTORABLE/RECONSTRUCTABLE/ALREADY_APPLIED/CONFLICTED/INVALID）; only ALREADY_APPLIED recovers the result WITHOUT re-running the writer（C8 duplicateSuppressed=1）; ambiguous state fails closed（C5/C6/C7 RECOVERY_REQUIRED）.
outcomes.sideEffectDedup: writerSideEffectId deterministic per (executionId, phase, generation); commit-marker persisted before successors（effectively-once within the governed writer contract）.
outcomes.worktreeRestoration: worktree identity + verified flag + baseline digest persisted in the checkpoint; resume wipes execution-scoped scratch and reconstructs（no stale worktree/clone collisions）.
outcomes.leaseRecovery: stale containers reclaimed on resume（cleanupStale）; single-writer invariant preserved（scheduler lease unchanged）.
outcomes.repairBudget: repairBudgetUsed persisted in the checkpoint and preserved across restart（C10 verified）.
outcomes.cbmRecovery: write-back remains post-final + idempotent（CBM-4 contract unchanged）; resume never re-runs write-back of a completed run（terminal detection）.
outcomes.d7Telemetry: recovery provenance（executionAttempt/recoveryGeneration/replayOf/resumed/recovered/duplicateSuppressed）added to the COST-1 allowlist + graph observer; recovered results are never double-counted（test:telemetry 37/37 green）.
outcomes.corruptState: tampered checkpoint -> SNAPSHOT_CHECKSUM_MISMATCH fail-closed（C15）; unknown post-head events fail closed（F1 classifier 'invalid'）.
outcomes.emptyProcessRestart: crash matrix runs resume in a genuinely NEW process（child worker SIGKILL -> fresh resume worker）reconstructing from durable artifacts only（Stage 25）.
outcomes.checkpointSerialization: REPAIR: per-run chain serializes checkpoint publication — fast phases can no longer CAS-collide（CHECKPOINT_STALE_REVISION）between runner-view and lifecycle checkpoints.
outcomes.finalSourceBinding: REPAIR: implementationDigest over the final production source + focused tests; reviewer identity = sha256({graphRunId, reviewOutcomes, implementationDigest}); graph-closeout evidence carries the same reviewBinding block — a change to the durable wiring provably changes the review identity + evidence SHA.

safetyHardGates: crash matrix C0-C15: lostCompletedResult=0, duplicateLogicalWriterMutation=0, falsePass=0, repairBudgetReset=0, corruptionSilentlyIgnored=0. Recoverability HOLDs（C5/C6/C7 RECOVERY_REQUIRED）are documented fail-closed classifications, not safety failures.
compatibility: scheduler / ready set / single writer / colima isolation / reviewer / repair / CBM / COST-1 / governance closeout / evidence identity all preserved — durability adds lifecycle metadata only（existing suites green: c3 41/41, v2 368/368, telemetry 37/37, governance 229/229, writeback/security/retrieval green; canonical colima-all per Stage 24）.
